## I4 verifying boundary

I4 adds one shared futures-state/AMU owner for CL admission plus committed execution, merges the ordinary bridge and R01-prebuild order sources ahead of risk, and feeds only accepted original payloads into the pinned frozen `financial_protocol_encoder`.

The first real pinned-AMU parity run revealed and corrected an integration response-contract bug: new-key INSERT success is `ok=1/status=OK/found=0`. The corrected controller/stub/regression stack is now exact-head CI green; the two local sign-off commands below must be rerun on that corrected head.

```powershell
pwsh .\scripts\run_i4_r01_parity_xsim.ps1
pwsh .\scripts\run_i4_r01_path_ooc_impl.ps1
```

The first command requires full 80-byte parity against a direct frozen-encoder baseline. The second requires the real pinned XPM AMU plus frozen R01 encoder to close on U50 at 6.400 ns.

## Project workflow

Start with `CURRENT_PHASE.md`, `docs/README.md`, the active ExecPlan and `AGENTS.md`. `docs/project_state.json` is canonical. Feature/research work uses one `codex/<phase-id>` branch and one PR through phase closure.

## Evidence policy

Simulation is not board evidence; routed timing is not packet latency; vectorless power is not measured board power. Futures margin v1 remains a host-configured research risk-budget model, not TAIFEX SPAN.
